title: Rules.
bodyText: All state agencies may adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91 for carrying out the purposes of sections 231-51 to 231-59.
bodyHtml: [§231-58]  Rules.  All state agencies may adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91 for carrying out the purposes of sections 231-51 to 231-59. [L 1982, c 199, pt of §1]
